'''Ludvika''' is a male [[NPC]] merchant visiting the [[Averardo Vault (Instance)]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mosto:''' Hello, my dear friend. Are you here for business too?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah.
:{{DIcon}} Just having a look around.
:'''Mosto:''' You're not from [[Rinascita]], right? Where are you from?
:{{DIcon}} [[Huanglong]].
:{{DIcon}} [[The Black Shores]].
:{{DIcon}} The lands beyond the sea.
:'''Mosto:''' Ah, such bravery cross those vast seas, facing the storms and the lurking [[Tacet Discord]]s...
:'''Mosto:''' Haha, reminds me of the [[Montelli Family|Montelli family]]'s motto. I'm not one of them, but as a [[Ragunna]] native, I respect their courage.
:'''Mosto:''' They sailed far and wide bringing back [[Terminal]]s, [[Shell Credit]]s, and mountains of wealth to Rinascita.
:'''Mosto:''' The [[Order of the Deep|Order]] wasn't too happy about it, and I doubt the Primus would want people lured by wealth, straying from the path of the Sentinel.
:{{DIcon}} What do you think about it?
:'''Mosto:''' Me? I'm not leaving Rinascita. Wealth or legends, none of that matters to me.
:'''Mosto:''' Even if I wanted to "fall from grace," there's very little chance of that happening. So I don't think about it much.
:'''Mosto:''' As a humble merchant with no great lineage, I'm content with what I have.
{{Dialogue End}}
